hook.en: A report says: of 100 students, 60 passed Maths, 50 passed Statistics, and only 5 passed both. Something is wrong. A quick test of *consistency* finds it.
hook.kn: ಒಂದು ವರದಿ ಹೇಳುತ್ತದೆ: 100 ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 60 ಗಣಿತದಲ್ಲಿ, 50 ಸಂಖ್ಯಾಶಾಸ್ತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಉತ್ತೀರ್ಣ, ಎರಡರಲ್ಲೂ 5 ಮಾತ್ರ. ಏನೋ ತಪ್ಪಿದೆ. ಸುಸಂಗತತೆಯ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಅದನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿಯುತ್ತದೆ.

title.en: State the conditions of consistency for two attributes

say.en: A report says: of 100 students, 60 passed Maths, 50 passed Statistics, and only 5 passed both. Something is wrong. A quick test of consistency finds it. In this lesson: State the conditions of consistency for two attributes.
Test given data for consistency.

body.en: Class frequencies that could actually have been observed together are consistent. Since no class frequency can be negative, data are consistent if and only if every ultimate class frequency is non-negative. For two attributes: (i) $(AB) \ge 0$, (ii) $(AB) \le (A)$, (iii) $(AB) \le (B)$, (iv) $(AB) \ge (A) + (B) - N$.
body.kn: ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ನಿಜವಾಗಿ ಸಿಗಬಹುದಾದ ವರ್ಗ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಗಳು ಸುಸಂಗತ. ಯಾವ ವರ್ಗ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಯೂ ಋಣವಾಗಿರಲಾರದು; ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಎಲ್ಲ ಅಂತಿಮ ವರ್ಗ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಗಳು ಋಣವಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ದತ್ತಾಂಶ ಸುಸಂಗತ. ಎರಡು ಗುಣಗಳಿಗೆ: (AB) ≥ 0, (AB) ≤ (A), (AB) ≤ (B), (AB) ≥ (A) + (B) − N.

Since no class frequency can be negative, data are consistent if and only if every ultimate class frequency is non-negative. For two attributes: i AB \ge 0, ii AB \le A, iii AB \le B, iv AB \ge A plus B - N. Each condition equals one ultimate class is greater than or equal to 0.

steps.en: A negative class frequency is impossible.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Test for consistency: N = 100, (A) = 60, (B) = 50, (AB) = 5.

say.en: Let us work this out together. Test for consistency: N equals 100, A equals 60, B equals 50, AB equals 5.
Abeta equals 60 minus 5 equals 55; alpha B equals 50 minus 5 equals 45.
alpha beta equals 100 minus 60 minus 50 plus 5 equals minus 5.
A negative class frequency is impossible.
So the answer is Inconsistent.

steps.en: All four ultimate frequencies are non-negative.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. Test for consistency: N = 500, (A) = 300, (B) = 250, (AB) = 120.

say.en: Let us work this out together. Test for consistency: N equals 500, A equals 300, B equals 250, AB equals 120.
Abeta equals 180; alpha B equals 130.
alpha beta equals 500 minus 300 minus 250 plus 120 equals 70.
All four ultimate frequencies are non-negative.
So the answer is Consistent.
